emma: Heads-up: onboarding sample started failing in edge-preview after we published the package with a stricter `exports` map. CI shows `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'`.

theo: That error usually means a CJS loader pulled an ESM `.mjs`. Did we remove the root `.` export or `main`/`module` fallbacks? Paste package.json snippet.

emma: snippet: ```json
{"name":"@redwood/sdk-starter","version":"0.6.0","exports":{"./utils":{"import":"./dist/utils.mjs","require":"./dist/utils.cjs"}},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"}
```

jamal: Yup. No root entry and no `./package.json` export. Some bundlers/edge runtimes prefer explicit root and package.json exports; otherwise resolution can fall through to import entries for subpaths.

theo: Repro: local Node 16.17 passes, but our edge image (edge-runtime) fails in CI matrix (node16/edge). ci-bot flagged it.

ci-bot: CI result: sample-app integration  matrix (node16/edge)  3/3 failed. See internal/ci/13579.

emma: Quick mitigation proposed: add explicit root export and `./package.json`, and keep `main`/`module` metadata as fallbacks. Proposed exports: ```json
"exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"./package.json":"./package.json","./utils":{"import":"./dist/utils.mjs","require":"./dist/utils.cjs"}}
```

jamal: Also ensure the published tarball includes `dist/*.cjs`, `dist/*.mjs`, and `dist/*.d.ts`. Some consumers import subpaths directly, and missing `.d.ts` files cause type-only imports to succeed but runtime to fail.

theo: Long-term: add an exports-change checklist to devex docs: smoke test on Node 12/14/16/18, Bun, edge runtime, `npm pack` install, and a tiny CJS/ESM consumer test. Add a simple CI job that installs the packed tarball and runs the sample app.

emma: I'll open a quick patch with root export + package.json export + `main`/`module`, run `npm pack` locally and publish a canary to re-run edge CI. Will update thread with results.

docs-bot: Note created: devex/export-migration-checklist.md (internal).

jamal: Also update onboarding README to show both `const sdk = require('@redwood/sdk-starter')` and `import sdk from '@redwood/sdk-starter'`. Saves users hitting this during onboarding.

emma: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/745  smoke tests queued. Thanks everyone :+1:
